message.content:
A vertical, full-page illustration for the magazine TEMPO, dated "20-26 OKTOBER 2014," features a man positioned in front of a massive stack of cut timber logs. The man, with short dark hair and a focused expression, wears a black-and-white checkered shirt over a white undershirt and dark trousers with a red-trimmed tool belt. He stands centrally, leaning forward while gripping a long, rectangular wooden plank with both hands.

The background consists of hundreds of stacked logs of varying diameters, showing circular end-grain with some cracks and textured brown bark. The wood pile fills most of the frame behind and to the left of the man. In the lower-right foreground, several more cut planks lean diagonally.

Large white text overlays the upper portion: "TEMPO" across the center and "KERJA, KERJA, KERJA!" beneath it. Smaller text at the top reads, "EDISI KHUSUS PELANTIKAN PRESIDEN & WAKIL PRESIDEN 2014-2019." The bottom right contains a barcode, the price "RP 40.000," and the website "WWW.TEMPO.CO." At the bottom left, text reads: "Klender, Jakarta Timur, Oktober 2014."
